service.description: Progress per language: how many distinct ledger texts exist and how many of them have a translation. There is no translation entity, the counts are the status.

parameter.name: locale
parameter.description: a single language, empty for all supported ones

actions.script: List locales = locale ? [locale] : LANGUAGES.keySet().findAll({ it != 'en' }).toList() if (search) locales = locales.findAll { it.contains(search.toLowerCase()) || LANGUAGES[it].toLowerCase().contains(search.toLowerCase()) } context.glAccountTranslations = locales.collect { String loc -> int translated = ledgerTexts ? ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage') .condition('locale', loc) .condition('original', org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.IN, ledgerTexts) .disableAuthz().count() as int : 0 [locale: loc, language: LANGUAGES[loc], nameCount: ledgerTexts.size(), translatedCount: translated, status: translated == 0 ? 'not translated' : translated < ledgerTexts.size() ? 'partial' : 'translated'] }

service.description: Queue the translation of the ledger texts into one language.

parameter.name: targetLocale
parameter.description: one of th, zh, de, fr, nl

return.message: There are no ledger texts to translate
${targetLocale} is not one of the supported languages ${LANGUAGES.keySet().join(', ')}
${targetLocale} is the language the ledger is written in
No Gemini API key configured: set it in System Setup or in the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable

actions.script: ec.service.async() .name('growerp.100.GlAccountTranslationServices100.process#GlAccountTranslation') .parameters([targetLocale: targetLocale, sourceLocale: sourceLocale, ownerPartyId: ownerOut.ownerPartyId, notifyUserId: ec.user.userId, username: ec.user.username]) .call()

service.description: Background worker: translate the ledger texts into the target language and store them as LocalizedMessage rows. Each batch commits on its own, so the counts of get#GlAccountTranslations follow the progress.
Translate the ledger texts with Gemini and store them as moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage rows.
Remove the ledger text translations of one language, so a run can be redone. The account names and class descriptions themselves are not touched.

actions.script: int removed = 0 ledgerTexts.collate(200).each { batch -> ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage') .condition('locale', locale) .condition('original', org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.IN, batch) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() removed += batch.size() } ec.logger.info("delete#GlAccountTranslation removed the ${locale} translations")

service.description: The translations are shared by every tenant, so only system support may change or list them. Returns the supported languages.

return.message: Ledger translation is only available to system support

set.from: [en: 'English', th: 'Thai', zh: 'Simplified Chinese', de: 'German', fr: 'French', nl: 'Dutch']

service.description: Everything the ledger screens show as text: the distinct GL account names of every company, plus the account class and account type descriptions. One translation row serves every company, because they all clone the same chart of accounts and share the class and type enumerations.
